## Pull requests are not accepted

**This repository does not accept contributions from outside developers.**

- Do **not** open pull requests against this repository.
- **No pull request will be approved or merged.**
- To modify the software, **fork** or **copy** the repository into a new repo you own and develop there under the [Apache License 2.0](../LICENSE).

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Local repository and Xcode

## Review and post-merge receipt

Stop for owner review. Only the owner authorizes merge. After merge, record a PR comment with merged/local/remote main identity, workspace result, and affected-check evidence. An approved or open PR is not a merged/synchronized result.

**Identity rule:** Contributions must use human identities only. Do not credit
assistive tooling in commits, authors, branch names, paths, titles, descriptions,
comments, reviews, or source. The **No AI Attribution** required check enforces
this policy.
